Name: Overgrown Flowery Interface - Mod Update Menu
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
I recolored the icons and buttons from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2536]Mod Update Menu[/url] to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166?tab=description]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url].

[b]Installation:[/b]

Unzip, put the "ModUpdateMenu" folder into your Mods folder, and let the files overwrite. (It only overwrites the images in the assets folder of the mod.)
